name: Monterey and Big Sur
tagline: Sea otters, cypress cliffs and the Big Sur coast
summary: Monterey is a historic bay town known for its world-class aquarium and sea otters, the gateway to the Big Sur coast. See kelp forests at the aquarium, kayak among otters, drive 17-Mile Drive past the Lone Cypress, wander fairytale Carmel-by-the-Sea and follow Highway 1 over Bixby Bridge to McWay Falls.
seasonNote: September and October are sunniest; summer mornings are foggy.
arrival: About 2 hours by car from San Jose, or 2.5 hours from San Francisco.
gettingAround: A car is needed for Big Sur; check Highway 1 closures.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere. Tip 18 to 20 percent at restaurants.
foodTip: Clam chowder, Dungeness crab and artichokes from Castroville.
